appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Increasing River Restoration Capacity from 2018 to 2023'.
Labeled 'Year', with tick marks for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
Labeled 'Capacity Index', with tick marks at 0, 400, 800, 1,200, 1,600, 2,000, 2,400, and 2,800.
A single blue line plots the capacity index over time.
The line starts at 2,800 on the y-axis for the year 2018.
The line drops to 2,400 on the y-axis for the year 2019.
The line rises to 2,800 on the y-axis for the year 2020.
The line drops to 2,400 on the y-axis for the year 2021.

printed_facts.fact: The line is annotated with data points at 2018 (2,800), 2019 (2,400), 2020 (2,800), and 2021 (2,400).

public_definitions: Assess the river restoration capacity dashboard for the 2018-2023 review window and send the record to the downstream route that best matches the overall dashboard trend.
Use the dashboard trend as the basis for selecting the most appropriate operational route for this record.
